messages:
alex: Draft PRD uploaded for a compact reranker + embeddings-fallback for the Redwood API. Short ask: help prioritize scope and acceptance criteria so we can decide canary vs full launch. Link: https://drive.re/redwood/prd-compact-rerank

maria: skimmed. main eng concern is added latency and memory pressure on dedicated nodes. do we have target P95 delta?

alex: ok proposed targets in doc: P95 added latency <= 120ms, token-cost delta < 12% on typical chat workloads. if we can hit both we go canary.

ryan: from ML side: compact reranker (128-d sim + light cross-attention) keeps quality ~98% relative. edge case: short chats where embeddings are sparse — need fallback path.

lily: acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) end-to-end top1 accuracy >= 97% vs current reranker on our eval set; 2) P95 added latency <= 120ms for hosted; 3) <12% token cost increase; 4) autoscaling behaves under burst + no OOMs; 5) rollout gating (quality and errors) in console.

sam: customer ask from AcmeCorp: must have per-customer pin to opt-out of fallback. also want audit log entries when fallback triggers. add to scope?

alex: add opt-out config and structured audit events to must-have. good catch.

maria: implementation notes: prefer opt-in per model variant + global flag. for dedicated we can expose config param in dedicated profile. need to validate config surface with infra.

ryan: edge-case list I care about: 1) embeddings not available due rate-limit; 2) embedding vector drift across model upgrades; 3) candidate set size < 5; 4) very long context where KV cache dominates. propose fallback order: a) use cached sparse embeddings b) fallback to fast lexical-rerank c) skip rerank and return baseline.

lily: QA checklist to add in PRD (short): - synth test for embedding failure simulation - A/B for quality with production prompts - perf test with burst 200qps - memory fuzz for longest-contexts

qa-bot: TEST_REMINDER: add automated test tasks: #T1234 embed-failure-sim, #T1235 perf-burst-200qps, #T1236 regression-top1-quality.

sam: launch criteria / gating proposal: start with 10% canary on hosted, 5 customers on dedicated (opt-in), require no quality regression >1.5% and error spike <0.5% for 48h. rollback if any severity-1.

alex: sounds good. last open: telemetry keys + dashboard. request: cost-per-request, rerank-fallback-rate, top1-quality-by-customer, p95-latency-by-model. who owns dashboards?

maria: eng-platform can own basic dashboard widgets; need event schema from ryans team for quality signals.

ryan: will publish eval metrics and event schema by EOD tomorrow. will include per-model vector-drift metric.

lily: I'll draft acceptance criteria into the PRD and add a short section on edge cases + rollback plan.

alex: thanks all. action items consolidated in doc. please add inline comments on PRD by EOD Friday. planning sync Thu 10am to finalize scope. :calendar:
